method: Three assembly PDF pages rendered with pdftoppm and inspected; four independently parsed Gerber images inspected; two mechanical previews inspected; schematic renders and final cartouches inspected.
findings: Readable reference/polarity drawings; no clipped assembly notes.
Gerber contours/route patterns and keepout appearance match native board views; drill positions checked separately.
Updated schematic cartouches fit and no longer state row spacing is unverified.
Mechanical envelopes show raised DevKit stack and taller terminal blocks; actual print/cables remain hardware checks.
limits: Engineering visual review, not assembler orientation/process approval or a physical fit/thermal test.
